method: Additional self-audit, selected before test execution; not independent kit/CHECKING.md certification.

facts.claim: $7BAF initializes zero totals, threshold 10,000, speed 4 and six reserves: seven lives including the current one.
$29FF-$2A06 awards 100/250/500/750 per life for modes 1-4.
Completion buildings $2A60/$2B83 are five cells wide and 8/10/12 high.
$2C00 flashes 4/5/6/all 15 window pairs for modes 1/2/3/4.
$5E6F expands eight consecutive 30-byte frames into eight 64-byte slots, leaving 34 zero bytes per slot; it reads 240 source bytes without a count or terminator.
Insertion $24A8 requires a strictly greater candidate; equal scores remain below existing ties.
Tune IDs 9/11/12/13 are identical zero-priority definitions: they do not silence occupied voices.
$9440 feeds title input triples on player pulses; demo $99DB runs on the opposite player-pulse phase.
$9A98 interprets actor records: $80 loads frame pairs/color, $81 sets position/enables, $82 calls a sound wrapper, $83 stops; other four-byte records specify signed movement and duration.
The demo frame loader clears offsets 1 through 128 of a 128-byte workspace, including one byte beyond its end.
Falling hazards fall three pixels per update at $3336, and expand into impact animation at $3385.
Every third collected bomb activates another hunter, capped at three ($3317, counters $3454/$3455).
$33E0 turns toward the player only on exact row or half-X alignment.
Four special records call $3282 for an extra 400 before the resident 100, totaling 500.
This overlay installs the standard collision callback $308F and no private moving-hazard routine.
Its IRQ $31FC advances Y by three and periodically queues erase/girder edits in stream $3288; main loop $3050 renders those edits outside the interrupt.
Animation $33C8 advances the effect on three of every four raster services.
Initialization $3161 randomly occupies 12 of 18 bomb locations.
Four special records reach $3667, adding 400 before the resident 100 for 500 total.

Three pursuers update at $32EB: equal Y causes horizontal pursuit, background contact selects upward motion, airborne movement steers diagonally toward player X, and crossing the top boundary resets an actor to its starting position.
